headline: V. N. Srivatsan assumed office as Chief Compliance Officer for 3 years
why: Senior management addition for a 3-year term, bringing ~34 years of experience from BFSI sector.

people.name: V. N. Srivatsan
people.background: Approx 34 years overall professional experience, including around 25 years in BFSI sector and close to 10 years in Compliance and Regulatory Inspection. Previously Head – Compliance: Overseas Banking and Subsidiaries & Data Privacy Officer at ICICI Bank Limited. Holds a PGDBA from PSG College of Technology and B.Tech from Sri Venkateshwara University.
